description: The transcripts of CML-TTS Dataset. No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are CML-TTS's transcript files, inside archives that total about 384 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
